claims.boundary: Rank-one Boolean switching is covered by Edel-Pott Theorem 9; the common trace-factor specialization is equivalent to BFA 2023 Theorem 3 / TPPA 2025 Theorem 3.2. Novelty may be claimed only for the arbitrary-kernel rank-r operator and precomputed forbidden-set formulation.

claims.claim: n=4 trace-zero coefficient characterization and EA reduction
claims.boundary: No exact scalar statement located, but dimension four has one APN class and the conclusion creates no new class.

claims.claim: n=6 coefficients are exactly the six elements of order nine
claims.boundary: No explicit statement found in BCL2009, EP2009, BFA2023, or TPPA2025. Full Arshad thesis could not be audited; resulting global class is historical.

claims.claim: n=8 rank-one coefficient fibre is exactly GF(4)^*
claims.boundary: TPPA2025 Example 4.2 supplies one member of this fibre, not the complete coefficient classification. One associated class is historical EP No. 6.

claims.claim: no nonzero coefficient exists for every even n>=10
claims.boundary: No dimension-wide nonexistence theorem for this exact scalar family located in audited sources.

claims.claim: complete P^1(GF(4)) rank-two displacement theorem and trace selector
claims.boundary: TPPA2025 Theorem 4.1 gives a general codimension-two criterion, but not this normalized projective classification, selector, or exact bad-section counts.

claims.claim: involution-only obstruction: four bad sections for each of three involutions
eight marked points partition into two EA/CCZ classes identified with EP Nos. 15 and 18
claims.verdict: new local organization of historical classes
claims.boundary: The global classes are not new; explicit Frobenius EA cycles and their occurrence in the projective family are the contribution.
Must be formalized as an invariant before title-level use; EP2009 already defines switching equivalence.

unresolved_risks: Full-text theorem-level audit of Arshad's 2018 thesis remains outstanding because the repository returned HTTP 429.

EP2009 tables were audited for formulas and class IDs, but absence of an equivalent coefficient parametrization cannot be proved solely from keyword search; manuscript wording must remain 'we did not locate'.
A final Crossref/MathSciNet/zbMATH citation search should be repeated immediately before submission.
safe_central_claim: We completely classify a fixed scalar relative-trace switching subfamily of the Gold cube in all even dimensions, prove uniform nonexistence above dimension eight, and classify its exceptional dimension-eight rank-two extensions by a finite projective geometry. The reached global EA/CCZ classes are known; the contribution is the coefficient classification, dimension rigidity, projective selector, and centre-relative organization.
